data.body: **P2 — Avoid adding collision-prone metadata to the existing plugin contract.** A previously compiled plugin may also implement another interface that already provides a `getExclusiveGroup()` default. The first validation call can then fail with `IncompatibleClassChangeError` because neither default is more specific. Existing OTel subclass methods can likewise override this group and bypass conflict detection. Use a new opt-in metadata interface with a distinct method name, or an inherited annotation, and add a precompiled collision-compatibility test.
